target_source: User-requested 5% at <=10, 5% over10 to24, remaining90% proportional to v9 longer-wait bands. Not measured hospital statistics.
calibration: Integer general roster and bed search against one fixed synthetic month; all trial results disclosed. Future demand and other seeds may differ. Same cohort, durations, categories, triage/specialists, priorities and flags as v8/v9.
waiting_time_generation: Unmodified event-queue simulation; no post-hoc wait editing, rejection sampling, forced minimum, or patient reassignment.
